title: (RHBA-2004:125) Updated eclipse packages contain various bug fixes/enhancements
portal_summary:
These updated eclipse packages contain several bug fixes and enhancements, including an 
upgrade to the Eclipse 2.1.2 framework and C/C++ Development Toolkit (CDT) 1.2.1.  These 
packages also contain new tools for developing J2EE (TM) applications.

portal_solution:
Before applying this update, make sure all previously released errata
relevant to your system have been applied.

To update all RPMs for your particular architecture, run:

rpm -Fvh [filenames]

where [filenames] is a list of the RPMs you wish to upgrade.  Only those
RPMs which are currently installed will be updated.  Those RPMs which are
not installed but included in the list will not be updated.  Note that you
can also use wildcards (*.rpm) if your current directory *only* contains the
desired RPMs.

Please note that this update is also available via Red Hat Network.  Many
people find this an easier way to apply updates.  To use Red Hat Network,
launch the Red Hat Update Agent with the following command:

up2date

This will start an interactive process that will result in the appropriate
RPMs being upgraded on your system.
portal_description:
The Eclipse Platform is designed for building integrated development
environments (IDEs) that can be used to create applications as diverse
as web sites, embedded Java (TM) programs, C++ programs, and Enterprise
JavaBeans (TM).

These updated packages include the following bug fixes and enhancements:

- Several enhancements to the Oprofile plugin
- Several bug fixes and enhancements resulting from an upgrade to the
Eclipse 2.1.2 framework
- Several bug fixes and enhancements resulting from an upgrade to the C/C++
Development Toolkit (CDT) 1.2.1
- Fix for problems with newer versions of CVS
- New tools for developing J2EE (TM) applications

Users of the Eclipse Platform should upgrade to these updated packages.
